title: Write a README for the real hooks/lib folder
pattern: file-by-file inventory, copied counts and function inventory in a README
expectation: Chosen because claude-plugins/task-orchestrator/hooks/lib has 16 files at 848db0fa0 (helper modules, two JSON tables and a catalog) and no README, so the right answer needs discovery in a large tree and a decision about what a reader cannot get from a directory listing. Without guidance the README lists every file with a line each, copies the file count and export names that change with every commit, and spells out function signatures. A pass says what the folder is for, how the helpers relate and what a hook author must know, and points at the files for the rest. The snapshot is the archive of the base sha, one commit, no history.

checks.pattern: scope creep: unrelated existing files changed
